# Portable Sketchpad fonts

Roboto: Copyright 2011 Google Inc. All Rights Reserved. Apache License 2.0.
JetBrains Mono: Copyright 2020 The JetBrains Mono Project Authors
(https://github.com/JetBrains/JetBrainsMono). SIL Open Font License 1.1.

Unmodified font files copied from the local Nix-cached source assets/fonts
(pqrkx91cxzmj0j1cjsi3l68b10jb82y5-source); the embedded font name tables contain
the copyright and license notices. License texts are included here.

Arial, Helvetica and Sans map to Roboto; Courier, Courier New, Fixed and MOCR
map to JetBrains Mono. Unknown names use the proportional/fixed flag. Serif
currently falls back to Roboto. Regular, bold, italic and bold-italic faces
are embedded into WgpuClient, so runtime installation and OS fonts are not needed.
